description.value: A Victoria institution since 1963, Mac's Cycle Centre is a full-service bicycle shop on Shelbourne Street known for its friendly, knowledgeable staff. They operate on a walk-in, first-come-first-served basis and offer quick triage service for flats and urgent mechanicals, often while you wait. They carry Devinci bicycles and provide a wide range of repair services from brake bleeds to comprehensive tune-ups.
